mcqs.question: The Remembrance of the Slave Trade and its Abolition, observed on 23 August, commemorates which historical event?
options: The Quit India resolution of 8 August 1942
The closure of the Semipalatinsk test site in 1991
mcqs.explanation: The observance commemorates the Saint-Domingue uprising of 22–23 August 1791. The other options refer to Hiroshima Day, Quit India Day and the International Day against Nuclear Tests, respectively.

mcqs.question: According to the National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums held in Mysuru, how many Scheduled Tribe communities does India have?
mcqs.explanation: India has 705 Scheduled Tribe communities, as highlighted in connection with the National Conclave on Tribal Languages and Museums. The figures 197, 26 and 21.76 belong to other current-affairs details and are not the number of Scheduled Tribe communities.
